title: Clearance Manifest Tier-1 delegated-attestor envelope v0.2
description: Tier-1 envelope: a byte-exact v0.1 payload carried inside a C2PA image manifest signed by a delegated attestor on behalf of the named (keyless) actor. The payload is UNCHANGED from Tier-0 (v0.1 spec): the integrity hash is the same byte-exact SHA-256 of the exact UTF-8 bytes of the `payload` string. Reaching VerificationState=ATTESTED_DELEGATE requires the C2PA claim signature to validate, the signer to resolve to attestation.attestor.did, attestor.did to differ from attestation.actor (a genuine delegate, not the actor self-signing), the bound-asset hash to match, AND attestation.actor to equal the wrapped payload's verification.determinedBy.actor. A tier:1 envelope whose signature, binding, or actor-binding fails is REJECTED (fail-closed), never silently treated as Tier-0. This is a v0.2 artifact; frozen v0.1 is untouched. The wrapped payload conforms to https://openclearance.org/v0.1/clearance-manifest.schema.json.

tier.description: Tier 1 = delegated attestation. Tier 0 uses tier0-envelope.schema.json; Tier 2 (actor self-signs via its own domain identity) is a future envelope.

payloadType.description: Media type of the bytes in `payload`.

payload.description: EXACT UTF-8 JSON serialization of the v0.1 manifest payload, byte-identical to the Tier-0 form. Hash this verbatim; compare; only THEN parse. The parsed object conforms to clearance-manifest.schema.json v0.1.

integrity.description: Inner integrity over the exact bytes of `payload`. Tier-stable: identical to the Tier-0 value because the payload is unchanged across tiers. This is the bundle anchor a sibling commerce assertion references.

hash.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the UTF-8 bytes of the `payload` string.

attestation.description: The delegated attestation. Attestor (signer) and actor (determiner) are deliberately distinct: the actor MADE the determination; the attestor cryptographically vouches for its FAITHFUL CARRIAGE, never for its legal truth.

attestor.description: Who SIGNED — the delegated attestor (e.g. Open Museum). NOT the actor.

did.description: Attestor DID, e.g. did:web:open-museum.art. The signing public key resolves via the DID document at /.well-known/did.json.

actor.description: Who MADE the determination. A verifier MUST reject the envelope unless this equals the wrapped payload's verification.determinedBy.actor (e.g. 'museum:met'). This is the binding the whole Tier-1 delegation rests on; it is a cross-field rule a verifier enforces, not a schema constraint.

boundAsset.description: The artwork image asset the C2PA manifest hard-binds to. The producer's delivered/print-ready rendition — the bytes the producer controls.

hash.description: SHA-256 of the delivered image rendition bytes.

binding.description: C2PA c2pa.hash.data / c2pa.hash.boxes hard binding to the asset.

locator.description: OPTIONAL: where the credentialed image is retrievable.

clearanceAssertionLabel.description: The C2PA assertion whose data is the EXACT bytes of this envelope's `payload`. Its hash equals integrity.hash.

manifest.description: How to obtain the C2PA manifest store (claim + assertions + COSE_Sign1 signature). Exactly one of `value` (detached) or `url` (embedded) — enforced by oneOf.

format.description: embedded = the manifest store is in the delivered image at `url`; detached = the manifest store bytes are carried in `value`.

url.description: Where to fetch the credentialed asset / embedded manifest store (format=embedded).

signature.description: The C2PA claim signature. Single deliberate algorithm in v0.2; an algorithm change would be a schema revision (no in-Tier-1 algorithm agility).

alg.description: COSE_Sign1 over the C2PA claim, EdDSA/Ed25519. The signer signs the lib-provided claim bytes VERBATIM — no re-canonicalization (mirrors v0.1 byte-exact integrity).

method.description: A CAWG identity assertion binds the COSE signer to attestor.did; the DID document at /.well-known/did.json is the public-key source. (X.509 + C2PA trust list is a heavier Tier-2/eIDAS-adjacent alternative, deferred.)
